dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system), compiled with OpenCOBOL/GnuCOBOL on Linux. Comment references 'open-cobol 0.23' and 'MONPE' (GnuCOBOL-related toolchain).
evidence: Project code name ORCA, Copyright JMA 2002

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – monthly receipt summary/tabulation program for Japanese medical insurance billing
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. It aggregates monthly medical fee receipt data by patient, insurance type, and department (科), computing totals for insurance-covered and self-pay amounts. It produces printed monthly summary reports (月次帳票) for medical institutions.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPCOMMONSHELL.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, etc.)
99 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram library
Large in-memory sort table: WRK-JR-TBL OCCURS 600000
Multi-level nested OCCURS tables for insurance-type/department aggregation
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary ORCA DB access via CALL
Fixed-format source with some lines exceeding col 72 (51 long lines)
Extensive change history in comments spanning 2003–2009
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese); decoded as latin-1 causing garbled comment display. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 212104 bytes (4463 lines). Dialect is GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as evidenced by explicit comment referencing 'open-cobol 0.23'. Standard is effectively COBOL-85 with no OO or newer features visible.
